hub_participant_invitation_fields.name: hub_participant_invitation_fields
hub_participant_invitation_fields.value: length("hub_participant_invitations"."email") between 3 and 254 and "hub_participant_invitations"."token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "hub_participant_invitations"."expires_at">"hub_participant_invitations"."created_at" and (("hub_participant_invitations"."accepted_by" is null)=("hub_participant_invitations"."accepted_at" is null))

hub_points_source.name: hub_points_source
hub_points_source.value: "hub_points_entries"."source" in ('manual','attendance') and ("hub_points_entries"."source"='manual' or ("hub_points_entries"."session_id" is not null and "hub_points_entries"."rule_version" is not null and "hub_points_entries"."rule_version">0))

hub_points_amount.name: hub_points_amount
hub_points_amount.value: "hub_points_entries"."amount" between -10000 and 10000 and "hub_points_entries"."amount"<>0 and ("hub_points_entries"."original_id" is not null or "hub_points_entries"."amount">0)

hub_points_reference.name: hub_points_reference
hub_points_reference.value: "hub_points_entries"."session_id" is null or "hub_points_entries"."activity_id" is not null

hub_redemption_fields.name: hub_redemption_fields
hub_redemption_fields.value: "hub_redemptions"."cost" between 1 and 1000000 and "hub_redemptions"."version">0 and (("hub_redemptions"."status"='pending' and "hub_redemptions"."fulfilled_at" is null and "hub_redemptions"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("hub_redemptions"."status"='fulfilled' and "hub_redemptions"."fulfilled_at" is not null and "hub_redemptions"."fulfilled_by" is not null and "hub_redemptions"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("hub_redemptions"."status"='cancelled' and "hub_redemptions"."cancelled_at" is not null and "hub_redemptions"."cancelled_by" is not null and length("hub_redemptions"."cancel_reason") between 1 and 300 and "hub_redemptions"."fulfilled_at" is null))

hub_reward_fields.name: hub_reward_fields
hub_reward_fields.value: length("hub_rewards"."name") between 2 and 80 and length("hub_rewards"."description")<=1000 and "hub_rewards"."cost" between 1 and 1000000 and ("hub_rewards"."stock" is null or "hub_rewards"."stock" between 0 and 1000000) and "hub_rewards"."version">0

hub_volunteer_active_group.name: hub_volunteer_active_group
hub_volunteer_active_group.where: "hub_volunteer_assignments"."revoked_at" is null and "hub_volunteer_assignments"."group_id" is not null

hub_volunteer_active_activity.name: hub_volunteer_active_activity
hub_volunteer_active_activity.where: "hub_volunteer_assignments"."revoked_at" is null and "hub_volunteer_assignments"."activity_id" is not null
